title: Sleepy raccoon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sleepy raccoon, curled up -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='34' ry='24' fill='#8a8f9e'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='22' ry='15' fill='#c9cdd6'/>
  <!-- tail curled around -->
  <path d='M18 62 Q4 66 8 80 Q12 92 28 88 Q40 86 42 76' fill='none' stroke='#6c7180' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 66 Q14 72 18 80' fill='none' stroke='#e9ebf0' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M27 87 Q35 88 39 80' fill='none' stroke='#e9ebf0' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='22' fill='#8a8f9e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='7' fill='#6c7180'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='30' r='7' fill='#6c7180'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#e9a7b4'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#e9a7b4'/>
  <!-- mask -->
  <path d='M38 44 Q58 38 78 44 Q78 56 58 52 Q38 56 38 44 Z' fill='#4b5060'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M45 46 Q49 50 53 46' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M63 46 Q67 50 71 46' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='58' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#e9ebf0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='55' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a3d4a'/>
  <!-- sleepy mouth -->
  <path d='M54 60 Q58 63 62 60' fill='none' stroke='#4b5060' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='56' r='4' fill='#f0a8b8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='56' r='4' fill='#f0a8b8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M78 24 h6 l-6 6 h6' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M86 14 h5 l-5 5 h5' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
